reviewed_by: Claude review of subagent restart reconciliation
reason: SubagentService.reconcile_after_restart marked a child that Core interrupted at restart as INTERRUPTED and then only posted its report when the parent conversation was idle. A parent parked in wait_subagents (turn status WAITING_CALLBACK) survives the restart because ChatService.startup only interrupts ROUTING and FINALIZING turns, so pending_turn returned it, the idle-only branch was skipped, and nothing ever called _resume_waiting_parent: the parent showed 'Waiting for 1 subagent to report.' forever unless an operator posted a manual resume. The INTERRUPTED branch now delivers through _deliver, the same path a settled child uses, which resumes a waiting parent or posts the report once the parent is idle. test_chat_subagents gains a restart scenario with the parent waiting and asserts the parent turn completes and its reply is posted; the existing restart, wait, late-report, stop, limit and deletion scenarios in the same file cover the neighbouring paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the remaining-core fallback for chat_subagents.py) is the real-Core journey suite and cannot restart Core mid-turn; the Python scenario simulates the crash against the durable store. No full suites.
